sentences.text: Since UTC began in 1972, every leap second on record has lengthened the civil clock, and none has ever shortened it.

assertions.text: Every leap second since UTC began in 1972 has been added to civil time; none has ever been taken away.

validation.text: Every leap second since UTC began in 1972 has been added to civil time; none has ever been taken away.

supporting.note: The IERS table of TAI-UTC lists 28 values from 10 s on 1 January 1972 to 37 s on 1 January 2017, each exactly one second larger than the one before: every one of the 27 steps added a second and none subtracted one.
